entities.summary: Tekirdağ Museum of Archaeology and Ethnography, shortly Tekirdağ Museum, is a national museum in Tekirdağ, Turkey, exhibiting archaeological artifacts found in and around the province, as well as ethnographical items related to the region's cultural history.
